subject: english
stem: You hear: 'I didn't SAY he left,' with stress on SAY. Which meaning is suggested?
options: No communication happened in any form.
The speaker may have communicated it in another way.

optionRationales.reason: He certainly never left.：否定範圍不是 left。
No communication happened in any form.：強度過度。
The speaker may have communicated it in another way.：SAY 重音否定說這個動作，不必否定整個訊息。
The speaker certainly said it.：與 didn't 相反。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「句子重音標出對比焦點，升降調顯示確認、未完或陳述完成等語用功能」可推出 The speaker may have communicated it in another way.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The speaker may have communicated it in another way. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
